Package com.workshop.mcp.spec

Record Class TaskResult

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.workshop.mcp.spec.TaskResult
Record Components:
resultType - ResultType.TASK, ResultType.COMPLETE, or null for a notification
taskId - the task identifier
status - one of TaskStatus's string values
statusMessage - optional human-readable description of the current state
createdAt - ISO 8601 timestamp of task creation
lastUpdatedAt - ISO 8601 timestamp of the most recent status change
ttlMs - milliseconds the task may be retained, null meaning unlimited
pollIntervalMs - suggested polling interval in milliseconds
result - the underlying result, required once the status is completed
error - the failure, required once the status is failed
inputRequests - what the task needs, required while the status is input_required
public record TaskResult(String resultType, String taskId, String status, String statusMessage, String createdAt, String lastUpdatedAt, Long ttlMs, Long pollIntervalMs, Object result, JsonRpcError error, Map<String,InputRequest> inputRequests) extends Record
The wire projection of a Task.

The same flat set of fields serves three different messages, distinguished by resultType and by which of the trailing payload fields are present:

  • handle(Task) answers tools/call with resultType: "task", telling the client the work is running and to poll for it.
  • detail(Task, Object, JsonRpcError, Map) answers tasks/get with resultType: "complete", adding the payload the status calls for — result when completed, error when failed, inputRequests when input is required.
  • notification(Task, Object, JsonRpcError) forms the params of notifications/tasks, which are task fields rather than a result and so carry no resultType.

Fields left null are omitted from the JSON, which is what keeps one record usable for all three shapes.

Since:
1.0
